name: Process Step 1 mask in ROI
hypothesis: Avoid expanding and eroding Step 1's mask across the full source image. Find an approximate eroded bounding box on the native mask grid, map it to source coordinates, then expand and erode only the corresponding source ROI. Preserve the existing Step 1 canvas/JPEG and full Step 2 path.
changes: Keep both segmentation models and all Step 2 operations unchanged.
Replace full-source Step 1 mask expansion and erosion with native-grid bounding-box estimation followed by source-ROI mask expansion and erosion.
Keep Step 1 masked ROI, canvas, JPEG round trip, and final regressor tensor preparation unchanged.

quality_policy.gate: same cohort, no failures, and no MAE, RMSE, or per-photo absolute-error regression
